typed_two_columns: SELECT ST_Point(1,2)::GEOMETRY('EPSG:4326') AS shape, ST_Point(500000,6000000)::GEOMETRY('EPSG:3857') AS other
renamed_typed_two: SELECT shape AS renamed, other FROM (SELECT ST_Point(1,2)::GEOMETRY('EPSG:4326') AS shape, ST_Point(500000,6000000)::GEOMETRY('EPSG:3857') AS other)
empty_typed_single: SELECT ST_Point(5,6)::GEOMETRY('EPSG:3857') AS geometry WHERE FALSE
empty_typed_two: SELECT ST_Point(1,2)::GEOMETRY('EPSG:4326') AS shape, ST_Point(500000,6000000)::GEOMETRY('EPSG:3857') AS other WHERE FALSE
mixed_measured_rows: SELECT ST_GeomFromText(wkt)::GEOMETRY('EPSG:4326') AS geometry FROM (VALUES ('POINT (1 2)'), ('POINT M (3 4 5)')) t(wkt)
filtered_mixed_measured: SELECT geometry FROM (SELECT id, ST_GeomFromText(wkt)::GEOMETRY('EPSG:4326') AS geometry FROM (VALUES (1,'POINT (1 2)'), (2,'POINT M (3 4 5)')) t(id,wkt)) WHERE id = 1
mixed_measured_two_columns: SELECT ST_GeomFromText(wkt)::GEOMETRY('EPSG:4326') AS shape, ST_Point(1,2)::GEOMETRY('EPSG:3857') AS other FROM (VALUES ('POINT (1 2)'), ('POINT M (3 4 5)')) t(wkt)
mixed_measured_two_columns_filtered: SELECT shape, other FROM (SELECT id, ST_GeomFromText(wkt)::GEOMETRY('EPSG:4326') AS shape, ST_Point(1,2)::GEOMETRY('EPSG:3857') AS other FROM (VALUES (1,'POINT (1 2)'), (2,'POINT M (3 4 5)')) t(id,wkt)) WHERE id = 1
null_first_row_typed_two: SELECT CASE WHEN id = 1 THEN NULL ELSE ST_Point(id,id) END::GEOMETRY('EPSG:4326') AS shape, ST_Point(id,id)::GEOMETRY('EPSG:3857') AS other FROM range(1,3) t(id)
